body_markdown:
A Zapier replacement needs to support the actions your business runs, not merely list the same app logos. Compare a branching workflow, its failure behavior, and the billable work it produces before moving reliable automations.


**Quick answer:** Make is worth evaluating for visual branching and data transformation. n8n is worth evaluating for technical workflow automation with hosting choice. Activepieces is worth evaluating for a visual automation and agent workspace.


*Published by Jet Admin. Product and pricing information checked September 26, 2026 against official pages and documentation. Recommendations are editorial judgments, not benchmark results or claims of hands-on product testing. List order reflects use-case fit, not a measured score.*

## What is Zapier, and why consider alternatives?


Connect business applications through workflows so events in one system can trigger actions in another. It suits teams that prefer a managed integration platform and documented connectors.


Start with the[Zapier official product information](https://zapier.com/) and identify which of these requirements applies to your team:


- Model action-level charges on a real workflow
- Check self-hosting or centralized governance requirements
- Test AI tasks separately from deterministic data movement


### When Zapier is still the right choice


Keep Zapier when its connectors, operations, and task economics meet the requirement. Migration is hard to justify if the current automation is reliable and has an owner.


## Types of Zapier alternatives


Connector automation, developer-controlled orchestration, and AI agent workflows overlap, but they are not interchangeable. First decide whether the bottleneck is app coverage, custom logic, or judgment inside a process. Then test a failure path as carefully as the successful run.


## What to look for in a Zapier alternative


- Does the connector support the specific trigger and action, including pagination?
- How are failed steps retried without creating duplicate business actions?
- Can a person approve, amend, or reject the proposed action?
- Who can inspect execution logs and rotate credentials?
- How do tasks, operations, credits, model calls, and concurrency affect cost?


## 1. Make: best for visual branching and data transformation


Build scenarios using modules, routers, filters, and connections. The visual flow is useful when a process has several paths and data transformations that an operator needs to inspect.


Official demo: a visual scenario connecting Google Sheets and OpenAI.[Official source](https://www.make.com/en/product) . Reused from the existing workflow article asset library; original capture date was not recorded.


**Why consider it:** Consider Make if your reason for leaving Zapier centers on visual branching and data transformation. Rebuild a branching workflow and inspect credits, retries, and the output of each branch.


**Trade-off:** A large scenario still needs documentation and an owner. Loops, polling, and repeated actions can change usage substantially.


**Pricing:** Free and paid credit-based plans; modules and specialized actions have documented charging rules.[Check current pricing and plan details](https://www.make.com/en) .


**Choose it when:** Your priority is visual branching and data transformation. Before committing, ask the prospective owner to complete the evaluation task and explain what they would maintain after launch.


Source:[Make official product information](https://www.make.com/en) .


## 2. n8n: best for technical workflow automation with hosting choice


Connect nodes, APIs, and code in workflows, with cloud and self-hosted options. It suits teams that want engineers to control transformations and integrations.


Employee onboarding workflow example with an AI agent, conditional routing, and Slack actions.[Official source](https://n8n.io/) . Reused from the existing workflow article asset library; original capture date was not recorded.


**Why consider it:** Consider n8n if your reason for leaving Zapier centers on technical workflow automation with hosting choice. Run the same workflow with malformed input, an unavailable API, and a repeated event.


**Trade-off:** Self-hosting shifts operational work to your team. Review the license and enterprise feature gates instead of treating source availability as unrestricted commercial use.


**Pricing:** Paid plans use workflow executions; self-hosted community and commercial offerings have different terms.[Check current pricing and plan details](https://n8n.io/pricing/) .


**Choose it when:** Your priority is technical workflow automation with hosting choice. Before committing, ask the prospective owner to complete the evaluation task and explain what they would maintain after launch.


Source:[n8n official product information](https://n8n.io/) .


## 3. Activepieces: best for a visual automation and agent workspace


Combine flows, agents, and connected applications in one workspace, with cloud and self-hosting options. It is worth testing when both nontechnical builders and technical operators will maintain automations.


Official workspace preview with support-triage and invoice-intake agents.[Official source](https://www.activepieces.com/) . Reused from the existing workflow article asset library; original capture date was not recorded.


**Why consider it:** Consider Activepieces if your reason for leaving Zapier centers on a visual automation and agent workspace. Rebuild one automation with a human review point and document how failures are retried.


**Trade-off:** Check that required pieces support the exact actions and authentication you need. Deployment choice does not eliminate infrastructure or governance costs.


**Pricing:** Free and paid offers with credits and team limits; confirm the current self-hosted terms.[Check current pricing and plan details](https://www.activepieces.com/pricing) .


**Choose it when:** Your priority is a visual automation and agent workspace. Before committing, ask the prospective owner to complete the evaluation task and explain what they would maintain after launch.


Source:[Activepieces official product information](https://www.activepieces.com/) .


## 4. Workato: best for enterprise integration and orchestration


Coordinate integrations, workflows, and AI agents with centralized governance. It belongs on a shortlist when many teams share business-critical connections and need a managed operating model.


Official preview of Workato’s AIRO workspace for building and managing automation.[Official source](https://www.workato.com/) . Reused from the existing workflow article asset library; original capture date was not recorded.


**Why consider it:** Consider Workato if your reason for leaving Zapier centers on enterprise integration and orchestration. Pilot a cross-system approval with centralized credentials, monitoring, and an accountable owner.


**Trade-off:** Enterprise procurement and implementation can be disproportionate for a few personal automations. Use a scoped pilot and a workload-specific quote.


**Pricing:** Vendor-scoped commercial pricing; request a quote for your usage and governance requirements.[Check current pricing and plan details](https://www.workato.com/pricing) .


**Choose it when:** Your priority is enterprise integration and orchestration. Before committing, ask the prospective owner to complete the evaluation task and explain what they would maintain after launch.


Source:[Workato official product information](https://www.workato.com/) .

Create AI-assisted workflows and agents that operate across connected business systems. It is useful when the job includes interpreting or generating content as well as moving structured data.


Gumloop Pro and Enterprise pricing, included credits and orchestration fee.[Official source](https://www.gumloop.com/pricing) . Captured September 26, 2026.

**Trade-off:** Model quality and tool permissions need evaluation alongside automation logic. Keep a review step for consequential outputs rather than assuming every generated result is correct.

## 6. Lindy: best for an assistant for recurring team work


Connect tools and company context so an assistant can help with repeated tasks such as meeting follow-up and record updates. Its current positioning emphasizes shared work and reusable skills.


Lindy monthly per-user pricing and credit allowances.[Official source](https://www.lindy.ai/pricing) . Captured September 26, 2026.


**Why consider it:** Consider Lindy if your reason for leaving Zapier centers on an assistant for recurring team work. Ask the assistant to prepare a follow-up, propose a record update, and wait for review.


**Trade-off:** An assistant is not the same as a deterministic pipeline. Test permission boundaries, approval behavior, and recovery when context is incomplete.


**Pricing:** Per-user subscriptions with credit allowances and higher-usage tiers.[Check current pricing and plan details](https://www.lindy.ai/pricing) .


**Choose it when:** Your priority is an assistant for recurring team work. Before committing, ask the prospective owner to complete the evaluation task and explain what they would maintain after launch.


Source:[Lindy official product information](https://www.lindy.ai/) .

## How to move from Zapier


Inventory triggers, mappings, filters, schedules, secrets, and owners. Rebuild in staging and prevent both old and new workflows from performing the same write.


- Inventory the data, attachments, integrations, owners, and access rules that the replacement must preserve.
- Separate transferable records from screens, formulas, workflows, and authentication behavior that need rebuilding.
- Use a limited pilot with representative records and explicit success criteria before switching the entire team.
- Reconcile record counts and key business outcomes, train the next owner, and document the fallback path.


Keep the existing system available during the pilot where your contract and technical setup permit it. Avoid simultaneous uncontrolled writes to two systems. Agree on a cutover owner and a rollback decision before the final move.


## FAQs about Zapier alternatives


### What is the best Zapier alternative?


Make is worth evaluating for visual branching and data transformation. n8n is worth evaluating for technical workflow automation with hosting choice. Activepieces is worth evaluating for a visual automation and agent workspace. There is no single winner across these use cases; choose the option that passes the representative test above.


### Is a free alternative enough?


It can be for a limited workflow. Compare the published free-plan or open-source terms with the required users, usage, hosting, integrations, and governance. A trial is not a permanent free plan, and self-hosted software still needs infrastructure and maintenance.
